CustomField.description: The Exam_Attempt__c.Section__c values this program's results are filed under, as a JSON array: ["FRM Part 1", "FRM Part 2", "FRM Full Program"]. Names, not rules — one program can use several. GARP_Portal_ExamResultsService UNIONS these with its hard-coded list rather than replacing it, deliberately: that list is a SOQL filter, so a row missing a name would make a member's results disappear from the page with no error anywhere. A value here can only ever ADD a section; removing one is still a code edit, where a reviewer will see it. Parsed independently of Config__c: a broken value degrades only this addition, with a named warning on the response.
CustomField.label: Results Sections
